test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people are sitting in a straight row all facing towards north. E is not an immediate neighbour of M and N. N is also not an immediate neighbour of M. M is sitting 4th to the right of L. I is sitting on extreme right end of the row. N is sitting fourth to the left of B. P is sitting third to the left of M and second to the right of N. Who is sitting at extreme left end?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people are sitting in a straight row all facing towards north. 

1) I is sitting on extreme right end of the row.

2) P is sitting third to the left of M and second to the right of N. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f462883ccfe68c9b7146a56b7c5fcb0ad4dddc711109f96aee0c57334cd7d5d.png] 

3) M is sitting 4th to the right of L.

4) N is also not an immediate neighbour of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e05af65edf54d9edbe75f38b9843532df554de98b902d544477688b57ab4a77.png] 

5) N is sitting fourth to the left of B.

6) E is not an immediate neighbour of M and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f06dee8a41d163fc8689f9067f35c79b514f5449e7d88be36fb8faa11bf009fe.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement N is sitting at extreme left end.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
